policy: One guarded CPU statistical worker has its own scheduling mutex. All original job IDs, output paths, artifact paths, source, environment, native fit/score parameters, full entities, seeds and resource floors remain identical. Reviewed scheduling replaces the waiting original controller; no additional independent repetitions.
required_transition: Verify exact original controller PID/create-time/command, waiting state, no active child, then terminate only that waiting controller. Preserve its state and logs. Never stop an active model.
